summary: Tested 4Luis crowdfunding platform UI improvements: 1) 'Mais Popular' badge on €20 option in CheckoutModal, 2) MilestoneProgress component showing dynamic messages based on progress percentage. All features working correctly.
passed_tests: CheckoutModal: 'Mais Popular' badge visible on €20 option when not selected
CheckoutModal: Badge has gradient background (from-[#FFBE98] to-[#E6A07C])
CheckoutModal: Badge has subtle pulse animation (animate-pulse-subtle, 2.5s duration)
CheckoutModal: Badge disappears when €20 is selected
CheckoutModal: €20 button has stronger visual emphasis (ring-2, shadow-sm) when not selected
CheckoutModal: €20 button shows selected state (peach background, checkmark) when selected
CheckoutModal: Opens correctly from Homepage 'Contribuir para este Sonho' button
CheckoutModal: Opens correctly from JourneyDetail 'Apoiar esta Viagem' button
MilestoneProgress: Shows 'Faltam 22% para o proximo capitulo: O Primeiro Passo' for ~3% progress
MilestoneProgress: Correctly calculates remaining percentage to next milestone (25%)
MilestoneProgress: Uses TrendingUp icon for normal progress messages
MilestoneProgress: Supports 'dark' variant on hero section (white/70 text)
MilestoneProgress: Supports 'light' variant on journey cards (#6B6661 text)
MilestoneProgress: Shows on Homepage hero section below progress bar
MilestoneProgress: Shows on JourneyDetail page below progress bar
MilestoneProgress: Has correct milestone labels (25%=O Primeiro Passo, 50%=Meio Caminho, 75%=Quase La, 100%=Sonho Realizado)
Tailwind: pulse-subtle animation keyframes correctly configured (opacity 1→0.7→1)
critical_code_review_comments: MilestoneProgress component well-structured with clear milestone definitions (25, 50, 75, 100)
Proper handling of edge cases: progress >= 100% shows completion message, remaining <= 5% shows urgent message with Flame icon
CheckoutModal badge conditionally renders only when €20 is not selected (amt === 20 && selectedAmount !== amt)
Both 'dark' and 'light' variants properly supported for different background contexts
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: MilestoneProgress and CheckoutModal improvements fully tested. Current progress on main journey (China) is ~2.5%, showing 'Faltam 22% para o proximo capitulo: O Primeiro Passo'. No ambassador journeys exist to test featured journey cards with MilestoneProgress. Badge on €20 option uses animate-pulse-subtle animation defined in tailwind.config.js.
